our_interpretation: The antecedent is the preceding paragraph's big-tech absorption of OpenAI or Anthropic.
Putter out means the residual entity eventually ceases substantive operations, rather than merely changing its name or leadership.
Eventually supplies no deadline. A finite period of continued operation cannot establish that the prediction is false.
